definition.name: Replace DirectShape from STL
definition.description: Imports an STL in feet as a DirectShape of the same category, aligned using the offset between the old DirectShape and its source STL, then deletes the old DirectShape.
definition.aiDescription: Imports an STL in feet as a DirectShape of the same category, aligned using the offset between the old DirectShape and its source STL, then deletes the old DirectShape.
examples: replace this DirectShape with a new STL export
swap the imported STL in this family for an updated version
